commands.summary: Plan and execute the create form reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally create form apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new live form in the Tally account
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally create webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers an external endpoint to receive form submission events
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create workspace reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally create workspace apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new workspace; requires the account to have a Pro subscription
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete form reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally delete form apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: moves a form to the trash, stopping new submissions
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete submission reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally delete submission apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently removes a respondent's submission and its answers from Tally
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally delete webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: stops delivery of form submission events to the webhook's registered endpoint; if this is the form's last webhook, the webhooks integration is also marked deleted
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm tally forms list --json
pm tally submissions list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update form reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally update form apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: changes a live form's name, status, blocks, or settings
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update webhook reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tally update webhook apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: changes where and whether an existing webhook delivers form submission events
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

examples: pm tally webhooks list --json
pm tally workspaces list --json
